name: actual_leaf_one_exit
header:
theorem actual_leaf_one_exit {E : Type*} {G : Graph Plane E} [G.Finite]
    {drawing : E → ℝ → Plane} (hD : G.IsDrawing drawing)
    {e : E} {v w : Plane} (he : G.IsLink e v w)
    (hunique : ∀ g ∈ E(G), G.Inc g v → g = e)
    (f : ℝ → Plane) (hc : ContinuousOn f I) (hi : InjOn f I)
    (him : f '' I = Graph.edgeArc drawing e) (h0 : f 0=v) (h1 : f 1=w) :
    ∃ (H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane) (r b t : ℝ) (C : Set Plane),
      0 < r ∧ r < b ∧ t ∈ Ioo (1/2) (13/24) ∧ IsJordanCurve C ∧
      H (f (1/2))=0 ∧ H (f (13/24))=Plane.mk b 0 ∧ H (f t)=Plane.mk r 0 ∧
      H '' (f '' Icc (1/2) (13/24)) = segment ℝ (0:Plane) (Plane.mk b 0) ∧
      C ∩ (H '' Graph.pointSet G drawing) = {Plane.mk r 0} ∧
      (C ∪ inside C) ∩ (H '' Graph.pointSet G drawing) = H '' (f '' Icc 0 t) ∧
      Plane.mk r (r/2) ∈ C \ (H '' Graph.pointSet G drawing) ∧
      Plane.mk r (-r/2) ∈ C \ (H '' Graph.pointSet G drawing) ∧
      Plane.mk r (-r/2) ∈ connectedComponentIn (H '' Graph.pointSet G drawing)ᶜ
        (Plane.mk r (r/2))

name: horizontal_coordinate_inj
horizontal_arc_image
header:
theorem horizontal_arc_image {f : ℝ → Plane} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hi : InjOn f (Icc a b))
    (hy : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, f t 1 = 0) :
    f '' Icc a b = segment ℝ (f a) (f b)

name: half_parameter_image
header:
theorem half_parameter_image (f : ℝ → Plane) :
    (fun t => f (t/2)) '' I = f '' Icc 0 (1/2)

name: interior_terminal_chart
header:
theorem interior_terminal_chart (f : ℝ → Plane) (hc : ContinuousOn f I)
    (hi : InjOn f I) :
    ∃ (H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane) (b δ : ℝ),
      0 < b ∧ 0 < δ ∧ H (f (1/2)) = 0 ∧ H (f (13/24)) = Plane.mk b 0 ∧
      H '' (f '' Icc (1/2) (13/24)) = segment ℝ (0:Plane) (Plane.mk b 0) ∧
      TerminalPrefix (H '' (f '' Icc 0 (1/2))) b δ

name: leaf_trace_decomposition
header:
theorem leaf_trace_decomposition {E : Type*} {G : Graph Plane E} [G.Finite]
    {drawing : E → ℝ → Plane} (hD : G.IsDrawing drawing)
    {e : E} {v w : Plane} (he : G.IsLink e v w)
    (hunique : ∀ g ∈ E(G), G.Inc g v → g = e)
    (f : ℝ → Plane) (hc : ContinuousOn f I) (hi : InjOn f I)
    (him : f '' I = Graph.edgeArc drawing e) (h0 : f 0 = v) (h1 : f 1 = w) :
    ∃ K : Set Plane, IsCompact K ∧ Disjoint K (f '' Icc 0 (1/2)) ∧
      f (13/24) ∈ K ∧ Graph.pointSet G drawing = K ∪ f '' Icc 0 (13/24)

name: punctured_jordan_preconnected
header:
theorem punctured_jordan_preconnected {C : Set Plane} (hC : IsJordanCurve C)
    {q z : Plane} (hq : q ∈ C) (hz : z ∈ C) (hqz : q ≠ z) :
    IsPreconnected (C \ {q})

name: terminal_one_exit
header:
theorem terminal_one_exit {A L C : Set Plane} {r b : ℝ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrb : r < b) (hC : IsJordanCurve C)
    (hA : A ⊆ inside C) (hL : L ⊆ outside C)
    (hleft : Plane.openSquare 0 r ⊆ inside C)
    (hright : rightStrip r b ⊆ outside C)
    (hcap : ∀ y : ℝ, |y| < r → Plane.mk r y ∈ C) :
    let T := A ∪ segment ℝ (0:Plane) (Plane.mk b 0) ∪ L
    C ∩ T = {Plane.mk r 0} ∧
    (C ∪ inside C) ∩ T = A ∪ segment ℝ (0:Plane) (Plane.mk r 0) ∧
    Plane.mk r (r/2) ∈ C \ T ∧ Plane.mk r (-r/2) ∈ C \ T ∧
    Plane.mk r (-r/2) ∈ connectedComponentIn Tᶜ (Plane.mk r (r/2))

name: original_leaf_unique_id
header:
theorem original_leaf_unique_id {V E X : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype X] [DecidableEq V]
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) (x : X) :
    ∃ e : E, N.graph.target e=N.leaf x ∧
      ∀ g : E, N.graph.source g=N.leaf x ∨ N.graph.target g=N.leaf x → g=e

name: original_taxon_one_exit
header:
theorem original_taxon_one_exit {V E X : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype X] [DecidableEq V]
    (N : RootedBinary V E X) (D : G1OuterLabelledMultigraphCurves.PlanarCurves N.graph)
    (x : X) :
    ∃ (e : E) (f : ℝ → Plane) (H : Plane ≃ₜ Plane) (r b t : ℝ) (C : Set Plane),
      N.graph.target e=N.leaf x ∧ ContinuousOn f I ∧ InjOn f I ∧
      f '' I=Graph.edgeArc (NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.curve D) e ∧
      f 0=NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.vertex D (N.leaf x) ∧
      f 1=NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.vertex D (N.graph.source e) ∧
      0 < r ∧ r < b ∧ t ∈ Ioo (1/2) (13/24) ∧ IsJordanCurve C ∧
      H (f (1/2))=0 ∧ H (f (13/24))=Plane.mk b 0 ∧ H (f t)=Plane.mk r 0 ∧
      H '' (f '' Icc (1/2) (13/24))=segment ℝ (0:Plane) (Plane.mk b 0) ∧
      C ∩ (H '' (NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.coordinates ''
        G1OuterLabelledMultigraphCurves.drawing D))={Plane.mk r 0} ∧
      (C ∪ inside C) ∩ (H '' (NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.coordinates ''
        G1OuterLabelledMultigraphCurves.drawing D))=H '' (f '' Icc 0 t) ∧
      Plane.mk r (r/2) ∈ C \ (H '' (NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.coordinates ''
        G1OuterLabelledMultigraphCurves.drawing D)) ∧
      Plane.mk r (-r/2) ∈ C \ (H '' (NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.coordinates ''
        G1OuterLabelledMultigraphCurves.drawing D)) ∧
      Plane.mk r (-r/2) ∈ connectedComponentIn
        (H '' (NanuqFaithfulSupplierDrawing.coordinates ''
          G1OuterLabelledMultigraphCurves.drawing D))ᶜ (Plane.mk r (r/2))

name: sampled_neighborhood
header:
theorem sampled_neighborhood (α : ℝ → Plane) (hα : ContinuousOn α I)
    (hinj : InjOn α I) {L : Set Plane} (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hLne : L.Nonempty) (hdisj : Disjoint L (α '' I))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (C : Set Plane),
      0 < N ∧ 0 < r ∧ r < ε ∧ IsJordanCurve C ∧
      α '' I ⊆ inside C ∧ L ⊆ outside C ∧
      C ⊆ ⋃ j ∈ Finset.range (N+1),
        frontier (Plane.closedSquare (α (sample N j)) r) ∧
      (∀ j ≤ N, Plane.openSquare (α (sample N j)) r ⊆ inside C)

name: rightStrip_preconnected
header: theorem rightStrip_preconnected (r b : ℝ) : IsPreconnected (rightStrip r b)

name: strip_misses_square
header:
theorem strip_misses_square {A : Set Plane} {b δ r : ℝ}
    (hterm : TerminalPrefix A b δ) (hr : 0 < r) (hsmall : 2*r < δ)
    {a x : Plane} (ha : a ∈ A) (hx : x ∈ rightStrip r b) :
    x ∉ Plane.closedSquare a r

name: vertical_cap_of_squares
header:
theorem vertical_cap_of_squares {C : Set Plane} {r b : ℝ}
    (hC : IsJordanCurve C) (hr : 0 < r) (hrb : r < b)
    (hleft : Plane.openSquare 0 r ⊆ inside C)
    (hright : rightStrip r b ⊆ outside C) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, |y| < r → Plane.mk r y ∈ C

name: sampled_terminal_cap
header:
theorem sampled_terminal_cap (α : ℝ → Plane) (hα : ContinuousOn α I)
    (hi : InjOn α I) (hend : α 1 = 0) {L : Set Plane}
    (hL : IsCompact L) (hdisj : Disjoint L (α '' I))
    {b δ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hbase : Plane.mk b 0 ∈ L) (hterm : TerminalPrefix (α '' I) b δ) :
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (C : Set Plane),
      0 < r ∧ r < b ∧ IsJordanCurve C ∧ α '' I ⊆ inside C ∧
      L ⊆ outside C ∧ Plane.openSquare 0 r ⊆ inside C ∧
      rightStrip r b ⊆ outside C ∧
      (∀ y : ℝ, |y| < r → Plane.mk r y ∈ C)
